title: Florida House, District 37
what_it_does: Represents District 37 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Open seat: Republican Rep. Susan Plasencia announced she would not seek re-election. Republican Robert Prater and Democrat Jane Aman qualified for the Nov. 3 ballot.
verified_ballot_note: Oviedo Community News (June 17, 2026): 'Republican Robert Prater and Democrat Jane Aman have qualified for the November ballot in the House District 37 race' (https://oviedocommunitynews.org/2026/06/17/whos-on-the-seminole-county-primary-ballot-for-2026/). Seminole County's notice of general election (https://files.floridados.gov/media/710299/2026_nge_sem_english.pdf) could not be read. Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.
